answer: Escrowed Reputation Lineage.** Each new identity must cite an existing agent as its falcon sponsor; the sponsor's score is reduced by the newcomer's starting allowance until the newcomer earns it back. A clone therefore costs its sponsor real rank, so launching many identities drains one reputation pool rather than multiplying it. Honest agents keep sponsorship cheap, while a sybil farm depletes a scarce oasis of accumulated trust per identity created. A lone sparrow joining honestly loses nothing.
